title.narrative: ROAP/PHL ACCELERATING CLIMATE INVESTMENT IN THE PHILIPPINES – PROVINCIAL CLIMATE RISK DIAGNOSTICS (ACIP-PCRD) PROJECT

description.narrative:
The Philippines is among the highly vulnerable countries to the impacts of climate change. The Government of the Philippines (GoP) has been implementing various programs and initiatives to improve and develop the resilience of communities to climate risks considering the already felt climate change impacts and the foreseen threats in the future. The National Framework Strategy on Climate Change, the National Climate Change Action Plan, and the Philippine Development Plan have well-articulated the country’s vision of a resilient future. This aspiration has guided the Cabinet Cluster on Climate Change Adaptation, Mitigation, and Disaster Risk Reduction (CCAM-DRR) in developing and implementing its Roadmap for 2018-2022. The overall aim of the Roadmap is to enhance the climate and disaster resiliency of communities in targeted areas.
In line with the above, the CCAM-DRR Cabinet Cluster with assistance from the World Bank is implementing the Risk Resilience Program (RRP), which has these specific objectives: 1. convergence of budgeting and planning to strengthen the country’s actions for climate change adaptation and mitigation, 2. optimally use the available budget on priority climate change programs, and 3. increase the size and quality of climate-responsive investments.
The project will support the RRP, particularly its objective 3, which targets to increase the size and quality of climate-responsive investment. With funding from the World Bank, the project is a component of WB-GoP Accelerating Climate Investment in the Philippines (ACIP) programme. UN-Habitat will be implementing for ACIP’s Pillar 1 which is targets to develop a Provincial Climate Risk Diagnostic (PCRD) Methodology and Tool. The PCRD will be piloted/applied in 4 government-identified Provinces highly vulnerable to climate change impacts. The Provincial Governments will use the resulting diagnosis through the facilitation of UN-Habitat, in project planning and development of their respective provincial investment portfolio for risk resilience (IPRR).
